update.releaseNotes:
v1.7.1 - Start works on phones with Android 14 or newer
- Fixed: Start no longer freezes on phones with Android 14 or newer (seen on Android 16). - Fixed: the bot no longer buys a skill's upgrade while logging it as the negative skill, and never fills rank spending with negative skills. - Changed: Android lists the accessibility service as "UMA Auto+", and dialogs use the screen width.
